sloka: सा चिरस्य आत्मजम् द्Rष्ट्वा मात्R नन्दनम् आगतम् ।अभिचक्राम सम्ह्Rष्टा किशोरम् वडवा यथा ॥२-२०-२०॥
transliteration: sā cirasya ātmajam dRṣṭvā mātR nandanam āgatam ।abhicakrāma samhRṣṭā kiśoram vaḍavā yathā ॥2-20-20॥

translations.english: Seeing her son who had come after a long time and who is a source of joy to his mother, Kausalya approached him with great delight like a mare to her young calf.
